## Takeaways

So what does all of this even mean? It all boils down to this, not all state representations are created the same. 
If this CW framework does so bad in a test like this then why is it used so frequently? As we've seen, in close proximity 
missions with a short time horizon, this method can do a good job at representing the uncertainty. It is also more simple 
for the everyday person to understand when compared to methods like ROEs. Everything comes with pros and cons, and it is up to 
the individuals planning a mission to understand the environment and decide which framework will be best for their needs.
